P1: 圆朱市 lies in the woods of northern Johto, between Routes 37号道路, 38号道路, and 42号道路. The city honors its past by preserving long-held traditions, like the old-fashioned architecture of the local dance theater and the two towers that stand to the north. Several legendary Pokémon have ties to the area, giving Ecruteak an air of mystery.

P2: Visit the southwest house and speak to the man inside. He gives you a Dowsing MCHN, a device that can detect any hidden items nearby.
P3: Enter the Pokémon Center to meet Bill, the creator of the Pokémon Storage System. He may have been the one to invent the program, but he credits Lanette, an associate of his from the distant Hoenn region, for making it easier to use. He mentions how he and his friends from all around the world are always working to improve the trading and storage systems, then leaves for home in 满金市.
P4: When you first enter the Dance Theater, you witness one of the Kimono Girls being harassed by a Team Rocket Grunt. He criticizes her dancing, and demands that she perform a dance that is less "serious". She refuses, and he then begins to demonstrate the kind of dance he would like to see by spinning around onstage himself. Speak to him to pull the troublemaker into battle!
P5: Afterward, he suddenly remembers that he has a mission to complete, and runs off. If you speak to the Kimono Girl, she mentions how you are kind and strong, and how "that person" certainly knows what to look for in people. When pressed, she explains that she was only talking to herself. Upon leaving the stage, the Gentleman in the audience approaches you, and rewards your courage with 秘传学习器03（冲浪）.
P6: The charred ruins of the 烧焦塔 lie in the northwest part of the city. Formerly known as the Brass Tower, it was once as majestic as the 铃铛塔 to the east. When it was new, it was said to be the roost of a silvery, sparkling Pokémon. But centuries later, a heavy storm rolled in and the tower was struck by lightning, igniting a great fire that would rage for three days. The silver Pokémon and the rainbow-hued Pokémon that roosted on the Bell Tower escaped to the skies unharmed, and the silver Pokémon flew away, never to return. A sudden downpour would finally douse the flames, and the rainbow Pokémon gave new life to three nameless Pokémon that perished in the blaze before it flew off as well.

P7: Upon entering the ruined tower, you can see three majestic Pokémon through the crumbling floor. There are also two men nearby; when you approach them, the first man introduces himself as Eusine. He has been tracking a Pokémon named 水君, and heard rumors that it was here. He directs you to peer through the hole in the floor, and states that the Pokémon is downstairs. However, he cannot approach any closer as it would simply run away, as it has several times before. If spoken to, the second man introduces himself as Morty, the 圆朱市 Gym Leader. He is here to investigate as well, both to help his friend and to properly understand the city's legends as its Gym Leader.
P8: When you approach the ladder to B1F, you are ambushed again by 劲敌（西尔弗）. He is looking for the legendary Pokémon that are supposed to be here, and accuses you of trying to get to them first. He aims to stop you, and draws you into battle.
P9: 劲敌（西尔弗） has added another new Pokémon to his team since the previous battle. 小磁怪 takes serious damage from 火-, 地面-, and 格斗 attacks. For Trainers who chose 火球鼠, or traded for the 腕力 in 满金市, it will likely be little threat. His 鬼斯 is still vulnerable to the same 幽灵-, 超能力-, and 恶 moves. Use 岩石- and 电 moves against his 超音蝠 for greatest effect. The Pokémon that he took from Elm's lab has grown a few levels but otherwise has changed little since the previous battle.
P10: Afterward, Silver shrugs off his loss as he moves to leave the tower, declaring that you would never be able to catch a legendary Pokémon anyway.
P11: Go north from the ladder to battle Firebreather Ned. Move westward along the few remaining floorboards to pick up an 解毒药 and fight Firebreather Richard. Turn south to find an ＨＰ增强剂 behind a breakable rock, then backtrack and climb down the ladder.
P12: On the lower level, you find yourself standing before three mysterious Pokémon. They do not react until approached, when two of the three immediately dash off in different directions and begin racing across the land. 水君 pauses for a moment to examine you before rushing off like the others. They can be encountered almost anywhere but flee from humans immediately. After seeing them in battle, the Pokédex tracks their movements.
P13: Eusine appears a moment later. He excitedly asks if you saw 水君 run past, and says that he has been chasing the beast for ten years but has never been this close to it. According to him, Suicune took notice of your presence, and Ecruteak's legendary Pokémon are said to only appear before people when they recognize their talents. He wonders aloud if he should be more aggressive in his search, and bids you goodbye until next time.
P14: The 铃铛塔 stands tall in the northeast part of the city. It is a sacred place, and is off-limits to all but a few people. Ecruteak's Fog Badge gets you inside, but no higher than the first floor. Two legendary artifacts are required to reach the rest of the tower.

P15: The Ecruteak Gym specializes in 幽灵 Pokémon. Ghost-type moves are super effective against Ghost- and 超能力 Pokémon, while Ghost-type Pokémon are weak to Ghost- and 恶 moves. 一般- and 格斗 moves will have no effect.
P16: The Gym features what appears to be a bottomless pit, with a narrow bridge crossing over it. Challengers who step in the wrong place are returned to the entrance. The Gym Trainers are positioned along this walkway, with the path to the Gym Leader mostly follows each Gym Trainer's line of sight.
P17: Morty's Pokémon tend to use indirect attacks to harass their target. 怨恨 and 诅咒 drain the target's energy, while 舌舔 and 催眠术 can inflict status ailments. Most of his Pokémon can even use 黑色目光 to prevent escape. 幽灵 Pokémon are vulnerable to Ghost- and 恶 moves, but 超能力 attacks are an equally effective way to target their secondary 毒 typing, instead.
P18: After the battle, Morty awards you the 迷雾徽章, which ensures obedience of all Pokémon up to level 50 and enables the use of 冲浪 in the field. He also gives you 招式学习器30（暗影球） as a prize.

P21: When you first approach the northernmost intersection, you are met by a Gentleman named Baoba. He tells you that he used to run a Safari Zone in Kanto's 浅红市, but it was becoming outdated with new entertainment options always coming out. His travels took him overseas to learn the newest technology and he has built a state of the art Safari Zone near 湛蓝市, to the southwest. The two of you exchange phone numbers so that you will be his first call when the new Safari Zone opens to the public.
P22: The Moomoo Farm depends on its herd of 大奶罐 to produce its milk, which is popular with people and Pokémon as far away as Kanto. Speak to the farmer in the farmhouse to learn that one of their Miltank has fallen ill, and will need Oran Berries to recover. Visit the barn to find the farmer's daughters tending to the sickly Miltank. In order to fully recover, she must be fed a total of seven Oran Berries. Once her condition returns to normal, the little girl on the left gives you a 贴纸盒 as thanks, and you can speak to the little girl on the right to receive three copies each of Fire Seal A, Party Seal B, and Flora Seal C. Visit the farmhouse afterward and speak to the farmer's wife to receive 招式学习器83（自然之恩） as a reward. From this point onward, 哞哞鲜奶 can be purchased from the farmer for ₽500 per bottle.
